products.name: SharePoint Online Records, Retention & Information Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: Apply SharePoint records & retention — retention labels/policies, records declaration + in-place records, and defensible disposition — scoped to SPO content and aligned to your Purview program. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Apply records and retention governance to SharePoint content

SharePoint content has to be retained — and disposed — per policy, or it becomes liability. This solution applies records and retention to SPO (scoped to SharePoint content, aligned to the broader Purview program): retention labels and policies for sites/libraries, records declaration and the records-management/disposition workflow, in-place records, and defensible disposition — so SharePoint content is retained, declared, and disposed on schedule.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — SPO records/retention: retention labels + policies, records declaration + in-place records, disposition review, and alignment to the org Purview program.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, records schedule from records/legal, existing Purview posture).
  • Implementation Guide — map the retention/records schedule to labels + policies, apply to sites/libraries, configure records declaration + disposition review, and validate — pilot-first; the records schedule itself and legal determinations come from records/legal.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (labels applied, records declared, disposition working) plus Best Practices; determinations deferred to records/legal, broader program to Purview.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

SharePoint content retained, declared, and disposed on schedule — labels and policies applied, records declared, disposition defensible — liability turned into governed information.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Apply-SpoRetentionLabels.ps1 — Create/verify retention labels and policies and stage default library labels (dry-run by default)
    • Assess-SpoRetentionPosture.ps1 — Read-only discovery of SharePoint Online retention/records posture across in-scope sites
    • Get-SpoRecordsComplianceReport.ps1 — Compile a SharePoint records/retention compliance report (read-only)
    • Resolve-SpoRecordsScope.ps1 — Resolve the records/retention scope and check module/connection/plan health (read-only)
    • Set-SpoRecordsDisposition.ps1 — Configure/validate record + regulatory-record labels and disposition-review wiring (dry-run default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
